We are Bambuser, and we are reshaping commerce     People no longer shop the way they used to.    Consumers increasingly discover, evaluate, and buy products through video. They want to see products in action, hear real opinions, ask questions, and feel confident before purchasing.    That's why some of the world's most iconic brands – including LVMH, Sephora, Sonos, Audi, Decathlon and Benefit Cosmetics, use Bambuser to bring video into their online shopping experiences.    But building great products is only part of the equation.    To earn attention, build trust, and tell compelling stories in a crowded market, every interaction with our brand matters.    That's where you come in. ✨      About the role     Design at Bambuser is about helping people understand.    Whether you're creating a sales presentation, a landing page, an event experience, a customer story, or a campaign asset, your work will help shape how prospects, customers, partners, candidates, and investors perceive Bambuser.    You'll work across Commercial, Marketing, Product and Leadership teams to turn complex ideas into clear, engaging, high-impact communication.    Some days that might mean helping sales tell a stronger story.    Other days it might mean improving a website experience, creating assets for a global event, or helping package a new product launch.    We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding the problem behind the brief. Someone who asks questions, cares about outcomes as much as aesthetics, and sees design as a business tool, not just a creative discipline.      What you'll do       Translate complex products, ideas and strategies into clear, compelling visual communication      Design and build digital experiences including landing pages, web content and campaign assets      Support commercial teams with presentations, customer stories and materials that help win business      Create marketing assets across social media, paid campaigns, product launches and brand initiatives      Bring Bambuser into the physical world through event experiences, print materials and branded environments      Continuously improve how Bambuser shows up across every customer and candidate touchpoint      Maintain and evolve a consistent, high-quality visual identity across channels      Collaborate closely with stakeholders across the business to understand goals and shape effective solutions        Who you are       We think you'll thrive here if you're naturally curious about why things need to be designed, not just how.      You enjoy understanding business objectives, user needs and communication challenges before jumping into execution.      You're comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on production, and you're energized by variety rather than confined by it.      You have strong design fundamentals, high standards, and an ability to bring clarity to complexity.      You know when to challenge a brief, when to move quickly, and when details matter.      Most importantly, you care about the impact your work creates.        We believe you should have       A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent visual design and communication skills      Experience designing across both digital and physical touchpoints      The ability to simplify complex ideas into clear, engaging experiences      Strong stakeholder management and communication skills      A structured way of working with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously      Fluency in professional English, written and spoken        Your toolkit     We care far more about outcomes than specific tools, but experience with the following is valuable:      Figma      Webflow      Adobe Creative Suite      Google Slides       Nice to have       Motion design experience      Video editing experience      Experience using AI tools to accelerate creative workflows      Experience working in SaaS, technology, e-commerce or high-growth environments       Why Bambuser?     We're operating at the intersection of some of the biggest shifts happening in commerce today: video, creators, social shopping and AI.    The opportunity ahead is enormous.    You'll join a company where your work will be visible, valued, and directly connected to business outcomes. You'll have the freedom to experiment, ownership to drive initiatives forward, and the chance to help shape how one of the leading companies in video commerce shows up to the world.    If that sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.     This is a  one-year interim position,  with the possibility of exploring future opportunities together beyond the initial term.

ff6467e3a1390318.jd:
The Role  
 Help us build the operating system for human longevity. 
 Virtusan is a Swiss-based longevity ecosystem at the intersection of science, technology, and premium real-world experiences. We connect data, behaviour, and environments so people can live longer, better lives. We're a small team and offer real ownership from day one. 
 We need someone who owns their work completely: defines the experience, conducts the research, designs the flows, and iterates without waiting to be asked. 
 This is not just an execution role. You will shape how our app is used, how it guides people through their health data, and whether it actually changes how they live. You will be accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. The measure of your work is whether users build real habits, understand their biology, and come back because the product earns it. 
 Tasks 
  What You'll Own  
  Product concept and experience design  
 
 Originate new product concepts from scratch, not just improve what exists 
 Design complete user journeys that translate complex biometric data into clear, motivating daily guidance 
 Ensure every flow serves behaviour change, not just usability: ask why a feature exists and what it helps the user to accomplish, not just how it should work 
 Hold the line on experience quality across the full app 
 
  User research  
 
 Plan and run your own user research: interviews, usability tests, diary studies, and in-app feedback loops 
 Turn qualitative and quantitative signals into actionable design decisions 
 Build and maintain a clear picture of who our users are, what motivates them, and where we lose them 
 Bring user evidence into every design conversation 
 
  Design execution  
 
 Build and evolve our next app version with fast protoptyping in Figma or Claude Design moving fast without sacrificing foundamentals 
 Design for the constraints of mobile: clarity, performance, and one-handed use 
 Maintain our design library and high-fidelity mock ups. Ensure consistency across components, patterns, and interaction models 
 Collaborate closely with product and engineering to ship what you design 
 
  Iteration and quality  
 
 Define success metrics for your work and track them 
 Test your assumptions before and after launch 
 Spot what isn't working and fix it, with or without a brief 
 
 Requirements 
 
 6 to 7 years of experience as a product or UX designer, with a portfolio that shows end-to-end ownership 
 Proven ability to originate product concepts, not just refine existing ones 
 Deep mobile app design experience: you understand iOS patterns, constraints, and work with a small screen 
 Strong user research skills: you design the study, run it, synthesise it, and act on it 
 Expert-level Figma skills and a clean, efficient design process. Experience with AI tools to accelerate the whole design process. 
 Fast prototyping and concept validation: you build lightweight, testable prototypes early to prove or disprove an idea before committing to full design. You iterate quickly on evidence and know when something is ready to build and when it isn't 
 Able to design for behaviour change: you understand how habits form and how design can support or undermine them 
 Strong written English: your product design copy is natural and is an integral part of your designed flows 
 Takes ownership: makes well-reasoned calls independently rather than waiting for direction 
 Based geographically in EU/UK timezone. Applications from Asia or the Americas will not be considered. 
 
  The following are strong advantages:  
 
 Experience in health, wellness, or longevity products 
 Experience building data products & data visualisations 
 B2C product experience 
 Fluency in German 
 
  Send a resume with a portfolio link or attachment showing work you have led: original concepts, user research, full journeys, shipped mobile experiences.

4c883a2a743561c7.title: Brand Designer
4c883a2a743561c7.jd:
About Co-Star 
 Someone downloads Co–Star every 5 seconds.  
 In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app.  Big Sean  has rapped about us, Ariana Grande &  Kevin Durant  post screenshots to their IGs, and we’ve been  App of the Day  twice. We’ve been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of  NYT Style . We have a global following, in 193 countries – missing just North Korea and Eritrea.  
 We don't pay for marketing – we designed the app to go viral, and it did.  
 Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years. 
 Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you’re experiencing, and how you relate to other people – in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It’s a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.  
 Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on.  An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.   
 We’re merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.  
 Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, Co–Star generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes – a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person’s unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. Co–Star combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called “wildly beautiful.” 
 We’re a small, experienced team.  
 Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia).  
 About the brand designer role 
 We're looking for a talented visual designer to shape how Co-Star shows up outside of the app, in the broader world. We are looking for someone with a fresh, opinionated, and high-quality design foundation who can create work that feels distinct, not what’s now but what’s next.  
 You'll partner closely with the leadership on campaigns and visual storytelling across earned and owned channels. This is a freelance engagement with potential for a long-term partnership as the work (and team) grows. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Design campaign visuals: ads, social, launches — from concept through finished assets 
 Bring editorial design sensibility to our owned channels: email/welcome series, blog, campaign imagery 
 Develop visual systems that are expressive rather than corporate 
 Partner with marketing on what earned and owned should look and feel like 
 Collaborate async with a small, fast-moving team 
 
 You might be a fit if 
 
 You're a senior IC — roughly 5–8 years in — with a portfolio of expressive, culturally fluent graphic design: editorial, campaigns, identities across print and digital 
 Typography and composition are your first language 
 You can direct as well as execute: you've shaped campaigns, not just produced assets for them 
 You're plugged into visual culture across art, fashion, publishing, music, and the internet 
 You work well remotely and independently 
 
 Nice to have 
 
 Editorial/publication experience (print or digital magazines) 
 Motion or illustration 
 You already make things with generative tools 
 
 Logistics 
 
 Freelance/contract, part-time to start, with room to grow 
 Fully remote, anywhere. No travel required (though you're always welcome in NYC)  
 
 To apply 
 Send your portfolio. We care about taste, range, and point of view.

 Companies ready to change the world come to Metalab to create products that improve lives, reshape markets, and shift culture.  
 As Executive Design Director, you'll shape the future of creative at the intersection of brand, experience and product at Metalab. You'll define what craft excellence looks like across the organization, lead with strategic vision, and ensure brand and product design remain a driving force in our work, culture, and growth. You'll coach and elevate other leaders, steward our approach to craft, and guide both clients and internal teams through high-impact, high-visibility brand and product design engagements—while also contributing hands-on at a world-class level. 
 You are a systems thinker, equally brand and product minded, a strategic storyteller, and a trusted voice across disciplines. Lead Product Designer 
  Team: Product, Research & Design  
   
  Prolific  
 Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models. 
  The Role  
 As the Product Design Lead in the Prolific for Participants Group, you will lead the design vision, strategy, and execution across three cross-functional teams. You’ll oversee participant experiences and authenticity within both our global marketplace and our dedicated specialist pool, as well as the internal services powering our participant models.  
 In addition to this leadership responsibility, you will be the hands-on designer responsible for the outcomes of a core participant domain, reporting to the VP of Product and collaborating with a world-class team of product engineers, AI researchers, and data scientists – as well as product managers and designers across Prolific. 
 You bring a background in crafting user-psychology-informed experiences for large-scale audiences and a natural ability to synthesize complex systems into elegant and transparent solutions. Thriving in ambiguity and juggling multiple initiatives, you move at a rapid pace while galvanizing exceptional performance around you. Ultimately, your success will be defined by your conceptual clarity, peer-to-peer bridge-building, and your consistent ability to bring the participant “into the room 
 Our Product, User Research, and Design Team indexes heavily on drive, commercial acumen, and pragmatism. Building on our Prolific Principles, we expect you to demonstrate reliability, grit, and bravery, and to model these traits within the team. You’ll be given a lot of trust and autonomy in return, as is always the case within Product at Prolific. 
  What you'll be doing  
 
 You'll bring your rich and varied design career experience to bear to solve customer problems and create new moments of joy for our participants who use Prolific—both ‘pocket money’ academic research participants around the world and deeply skilled experts working on AI training and evaluation. 
 You’ll build extensively for internal use cases and users, including in participant modeling platforms and tools for our Human Data Ops team. 
 You’ll raise the bar in our Design Team, and co-own cross-functional areas like accessibility (we are WCAG 2.1 AA compliant) and our Design System with other design leaders.  
 You will line-manage a group of 1-3 designers directly, and mentor others, coaching behaviours and skills, and modeling game-changing approaches by directly doing. 
 You'll have user research and data analysis responsibilities 
 
   
  What you'll bring  
 
 An extensive and varied track record of in-house product design work alongside product managers and engineers. (Pure agency experience is likely to be screened out.) 
 Experience in either line-managing or acting as player/coach for other designers. 
 Confidence working with AI prototyping tools. We use Figma Make. 
 Competence or expertise in the industry's standard design tools, principles, and methodologies, and a basic to detailed understanding of how AI models work. 
 
  Even better if you have  
 
 A lived experience of a rapidly scaling startup – especially if you loved it! 
 AI training experience, or a data science or computer science background. 
 A track record of giving back to your Product/Design community. 
 A track record of excelling across all your pursuits, beyond your chosen career. 
 
  Why Prolific is a great place to work  
 We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. 
 We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity. 
 Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

Work from anywhere, impact everywhere  
 Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.  We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world. 
 Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.  We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.  We are committed to changing the way things are done. 
  Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position    Work from anywhere!    Position overview 
 As the Head of Design, you will lead our design organisation, owning the design quality of every customer journey end-to-end — how our client-facing touchpoints across product, web and more look, feel, and function at every step — in close partnership with Product, who own the journeys and priorities, and Marketing, who lead brand strategy and identity. 
 This is a broad executive mandate where you will own not only the craft of design but its measurable impact on the business. You will champion design excellence, build deep partnerships with Product and Marketing to ensure a single, cohesive experience from first impression to daily use, and grow a world-class remote design culture. Your mission is to translate complex financial and cryptocurrency concepts into a beautiful, cohesive, and trust-building experience — and to demonstrate, through outcomes, that great design is working. 
   
 Responsibilities 
 
  Design Strategy and Vision.  Define, champion, and execute the long-term design vision for Xapo's client-facing touchpoints across mobile and web — treating measurable user-experience quality, not just aesthetics, as the standard of success.   
  Design Performance & Outcomes.  Own the metrics that demonstrate design's business impact such as task-completion and speed in core journeys and design-system adoption, reporting on these quarterly at the executive level.   
  Operational Leadership of the Design Function.  Run design as a fully accountable business function, owning headcount planning, prioritisation, and delivery, so the organization scales predictably alongside Product and Engineering.   
  Brand Partnership and Experience Continuity.  Partner closely with Marketing, who lead Xapo's brand strategy and identity, to ensure that brand is expressed faithfully throughout the user journey — creating a seamless aesthetic and narrative transition from public campaigns to in-app transactional flows, with clear swimlanes and shared rituals between the two teams.   
  UX Architecture and Flow Optimisation.  Oversee user research and journey mapping to elevate the design and usability of complex regulatory, private banking, and crypto-native payment flows — working with Product, who own the journeys themselves, to reduce friction without compromising security.   
  Design Systems and Operations.  Scale and govern a unified design language and Figma system — co-developed with Marketing's brand team where the system touches brand expression — to drive velocity, consistency, and visual quality across product and web.   
  Operationalised Research and Testing.  Standardise a culture of data-informed design, embedding regular usability testing and customer discovery as a standard gate before handoff to ensure high-quality, validated releases.   
  Cross-Functional Executive Collaboration.  Work closely with Product and Engineering leadership so the design organisation is engaged early, bringing craft and usability expertise into strategic direction and product requirements from the earliest stages — and act as design's ambassador to Marketing, Compliance, and other key stakeholders.   
  Responsible AI Design Governance.  Partner with security and AI engineering teams to establish a safe, governed framework for utilising AI tools in asset creation and UX personalisation.   
  Team Leadership and Culture.  Recruit, mentor, and lead a remote, multi-disciplinary design organisation spanning Product Design, Research, and UX Writing, fostering a culture of craft, critique, and continuous growth. 
 
   
 Skills needed 
 
 10+ years of digital design experience, with at least 4+ years in an executive leadership role (Director/VP) managing multi-disciplinary design teams in a high-growth fintech, neobank, or digital asset platform.   
 Broad creative fluency, with a strong portfolio demonstrating complex interactive product design executed to a high aesthetic standard, and a proven ability to work within and extend an established brand identity.   
 Proven track record of improving key business and design metrics (conversion, NPS, task completion, and platform ratings) through design-led initiatives.   
 Demonstrated ability to resolve operational friction, streamline design workflows, and build high-trust partnerships with marketing, product, and engineering teams — particularly experience navigating shared ownership of brand between design and marketing functions.   
 Deep knowledge of native mobile platform guidelines (iOS and Android) and modern Web standards, along with experience scaling enterprise-grade design systems.   
 Strong familiarity with the unique UX and trust challenges in fintech, banking, and digital assets.   
 Exceptional communication and executive storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate the business value of design decisions to the C-suite and board.   
 Operational, direct, and collaborative leadership style tailored for a fully remote, globally distributed environment. 
 
   
  Other requirements  
   
 
 A dedicated workspace. 
 A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area. 
 Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles. 
   Why work for Xapo? 
 Impact Globally, Work Remotely. 
 
 
  Shape the Future   Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.   
 
 
  Great work-life balance   Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.      
 
 
  Expect Excellence   Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn   how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.    
 
 
 At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

Who we are  
 Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  
 As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. 
 Who we are 
 Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  
 As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. 
  About This Role  
 We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (Design System) who thinks at a system level and understands how to create a scalable UI ecosystem that spans multiple products, teams, and platforms. You are not just designing static screens; you are building the foundation of our product user interfaces. In this role, you will take full ownership of our component libraries, interaction models, and cross-platform design consistency. You will act as the bridge between design and engineering, ensuring that our visual assets translate seamlessly into clean, reusable, and accessible production code. 
  Responsibilities  
 
 UI Craft & Visual Excellence: Maintain an exceptionally high standard for layout, typography, colour, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall digital finish across all reusable elements. 
 Component Architecture: Design, build, and maintain robust component libraries (buttons, inputs, cards, navigation, forms, tables, etc.) that scale seamlessly across products. 
 Interaction & Motion Design: Define interactive behaviors and state transitions (e.g., hover, focus, disabled, loading, and mobile behaviors) to ensure components feel alive and intuitive. 
 Design Token Management: Structure and maintain design tokens (colours, spacing, typography, border-radius, shadows) to drive consistency between design environments and code. 
 Figma Library Architecture: Organize complex variants, properties, and components within Figma to empower other product designers to build quickly and accurately. 
 Engineering Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering teams to navigate technical constraints across Web, React, Flutter, Android, and iOS/Native app environments. 
 Documentation & Governance: Create clear, comprehensive usage guidelines and documentation outlining when, why, and how components should (and should not) be used. 
 
  Experience & Background  
 
 Proven Design System Track Record: Extensive experience building, scaling, and maintaining production-ready design systems rather than just standalone product features. 
 Cross-Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of the constraints and guidelines governing multiple platforms, including Web, iOS, and Android. 
 Systems-Thinking Mindset: A portfolio demonstrating how individual design decisions impact multiple products, scale sustainably, and optimize designer/engineer workflows. 
 Front-End Alignment: Strong familiarity with how developers inspect, build, and consume components in code repositories. 
 
  Skills & Competencies  
 
 Expert Figma Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Figma libraries, auto-layout, components, variants, variables, and library publication. 
 Accessibility Champion: Solid grasp of accessibility standards (WCAG), contrast requirements, and inclusive design principles. 
 Technical Literacy: Familiarity with component-driven frameworks (React, Flutter) and Atomic Design methodology. 
 Communication & Documentation: Excellent writing and presentation skills, with an ability to translate complex design system choices into clear executive-level updates and technical guidelines. 
 
  What Success Looks Like in This Role  
 
 High Adoption & Efficiency: Design and engineering teams actively use the system, resulting in significantly accelerated product shipping cycles. 
 Flawless Cross-Platform Consistency: A unified look, feel, and interactive behavior across all customer-facing touchpoints (Web, Android, iOS). 
 Best-in-Class Documentation: A central, living source of truth that leaves no ambiguity regarding design tokens, component rules, or brand compliance. 
 Scalable Architecture: A foundational library that handles future product expansions, rebrands, or theme changes with minimal friction. 
 
  Why Join Us  
 
 Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities. 
 Fully remote work culture and support for professional development. 
 
  How to apply:  
 Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

About SecurityScorecard:   
  SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint.   
   Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of the      World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023    and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.”  SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.   
   About the Role:   
  We're hiring a Senior UX Architect to own information architecture and structural UX across our entire product surface — new platform builds and legacy areas alike. This is a senior, horizontal role that sits just below the leadership tier and carries genuine influence over how our product is structured and how our design org thinks.  
  Today, much of our structural UX expertise lives in one place at the leadership level. This role exists to scale that expertise across every product swimlane — shifting the team from aesthetic-first to architecture-first design thinking, where great aesthetics are the  result  of sound structure, not a substitute for it. You'll also be the structural foundation our AI product work builds on, ensuring intelligent product experiences sit on top of a clean, scalable UX layer rather than inheriting structural debt.  
  This is the kind of work that quietly determines whether a product feels effortless or exhausting — and whether customers stay. If you want to be the person who sets and holds that bar across an entire platform, this is your seat.  
   What You'll Do:   
 
   Own information architecture across all surfaces.  Maintain a coherent IA across new and legacy platform areas. Audit existing structures, find the fracture points, and resolve them with a long-term foundation in mind.  
   Set and carry cross-swimlane UX standards.  Operate horizontally across every product design swimlane, ensuring structural UX thinking is applied consistently — everywhere the product lives, not just where attention happens to land.  
   Be the quality checkpoint for prototypes.  Review prototypes across product areas as a structural-integrity gate, so work moves forward faster and with confidence — and nothing ships with structural debt baked in.  
   Champion a blueprint-first design motion.  As the org adopts a blueprint-first approach (defining the  what  and  how  in low fidelity before any high-fidelity layer), you'll be the keeper of the bar — ensuring every output meets our UX, IA, and best-practice standards.  
   Elevate the design practice.  Coach and model what strong structural thinking looks like, leveling up the team so it builds things right from the start rather than requiring correction after the fact.  
   Build the UX foundation for AI products.  Partner closely with the AI product team to ensure the UX layer is structured, scalable, and ready to support intelligent product experiences.  
   Hold platform integrity — old and new.  Maintain the standard across the current platform and future builds, progressively bringing legacy areas up to standard.  
   Transfer knowledge and level the team.  Spread UX architecture thinking throughout the design org, building a team that constructs correctly from the start.  
 
   What You'll Bring:   
 
  8+ years of hands-on and/or managerial  UX experience  with deep, demonstrated expertise in  information architecture  and  structural/systems-level SaaS design .  
  A track record of owning IA across complex, multi-surface products — including untangling fractured or legacy structures.  
  The ability to set standards and influence horizontally across multiple teams without direct authority — leadership through craft and clarity.  
  Experience establishing design processes, review practices, and reusable patterns/component foundations at scale.  
  Fluency partnering with Product and Engineering on AI or platform-level initiatives, with an eye for building UX foundations that scale.  
  The judgment to know when aesthetics are doing real structural work and when they're papering over a weak foundation.  
   Leader mentality:  An excellent communicator, patient observer, and a keen feedback-giver.  
  Engineering experience (JSON, CSS, C++) / Python-ML background — a plus.  
 
  UX Architecture & IA Health  
 
  A measurable reduction in IA-related rework and structural revisions after handoff.  
  Every prototype reviewed against blueprint-first standards before progressing.  
  A clear decline in siloed design decisions across product swimlanes.  
 
  Design Velocity  
 
  Prototype review cycles compressed from weeks to days.  
  Fewer design-to-dev miscommunication loops and back-and-forth cycles.  
  Blueprint completion consistently running ahead of visual design sprints.  
 
  Customer Impact  
 
  Quarter-over-quarter NPS improvement.  
  Increased platform and customer retention.  
  Fewer support tickets and friction points tied to navigation, IA, and workflow confusion.  
 
  AI & Platform Readiness  
 
  Core platform surfaces assessed and documented as AI-ready.  
  Zero new AI features shipped on top of unresolved IA debt.  
  A clean, consistent component and pattern library established as the foundation for AI product builds.  
 
  Team Elevation  
 
  Measurable uplift in the team's blueprint-first output quality over 6–12 months.  
  A steady reduction in leadership-level intervention required on structural UX decisions.  
  UX standards adopted and self-applied across swimlanes — without top-down correction.  
 
  Who You Are:  
  Our Experience Design & Research team has a unique fabric, and we hire for it  deliberately  — at this level, how you carry it matters as much as your expertise:  
 
   You push yourself to do your best work.  You set a high structural bar and you're energized by getting the foundation right.  
   You have a growth mindset.  You seek out feedback and incorporate it, and you create the conditions for others to do the same.  
   You care about the people around you.  You're committed to elevating the whole team. This is not a "rockstar" seat — it's a force-multiplier seat. You make everyone better.  
   You lead with humility.  You're deeply experienced and entirely secure — which is exactly why you can coach, listen, and influence rather than dictate.  
 
   Benefits:   Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!

Actual compensation for the position is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to affordability, skills, qualifications and experience, and may vary from the range. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible for annual performance-based incentive compensation awards and equity, among other company benefits.

2f4ffe980126ea5c.jd:
About Nscale  
 Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility. 
 We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future. 
  About the Role  
 This role owns the design and technical integrity of the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS), including the PLC-based SCADA architecture built on Ignition, per Nscale's standardized PLC/SCADA control architectures. 
 You'll operate at the intersection of mechanical engineering, automation, and commissioning, working closely with internal controls engineers, mechanical designers, OEMs, skid manufacturers, system integrators, and field commissioning teams to ensure equipment integrates seamlessly into Nscale's BMS and EPMS environments and supports scalable, repeatable deployments. 
 You'll author and own Nscale's standard library of control sequences and points lists: a Sequence of Operations (SOO) and a matching points list for every type of mechanical and electrical equipment and system deployed in a North America facility. You'll maintain a governed, versioned, reusable set of sequences and points lists that every project, vendor, and integrator is designed and built to, making control behavior deterministic, comparable, and repeatable across a growing portfolio. 
 This is a senior individual contributor role that carries design authority. You'll set the standard, hold design consultants, OEMs, and system integrators to it through submittal review, factory testing, and commissioning, and work directly with mechanical, electrical, CSA, construction, commissioning, and Operations teams to make sure what gets built matches what was specified. 
  What You'll be Doing  
 - **Standard SOO Library.** Author, own, and maintain the standard Sequence of Operations for every equipment type and system deployed in an Nscale facility, including chilled water plants, CDUs and liquid cooling, chillers, dry coolers, CRAH/CRAC units, air handling and ventilation, pumping systems, humidification, leak detection, generators, UPS, switchgear and ATS, and building-level systems. - **Standard Points Lists & Data Model.** Own the standard points list, naming, and tagging convention for each equipment type, including per-point attributes such as signal type, units, range, alarm limits, and historian requirements. - **P&ID Development.** Develop, review, and own P&IDs for mechanical and electrical systems, keeping sequences, points lists, and P&IDs as one coherent, version-controlled design set. - **BMS & Mechanical Controls Design.** Serve as the primary controls SME for datacenter cooling systems including CDUs, chillers, dry coolers, CRAH/CRAC units, and direct-to-chip liquid cooling skids. - **EPMS & Electrical Monitoring Design.** Define metering topology, breaker and switchgear status monitoring, power quality capture, and alarm hierarchy across the electrical distribution chain. - **Vendor, OEM & System Integrator Management.** Define required control interfaces, issue Nscale sequences and points lists as the binding technical basis for vendor scope, and review integrator programming submittals. - **Risk, Reliability & Commissioning.** Participate in FMEA sessions and design reviews, and own controls scope through HAT, FAT/CAT, SAT, and integrated systems testing. - **Documentation & Standards.** Ensure BMS, EPMS, and SCADA designs comply with Nscale OT network standards, and drive continuous improvement of controls design standards based on field performance. 
  About You  
 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Controls/Automation Engineering, or a related discipline. - 10+ years of experience in industrial controls, building automation, or SCADA engineering, including significant experience in mission-critical or industrial environments (datacenters strongly preferred). - Demonstrated experience authoring, not merely reviewing, Sequences of Operation and points lists, and building them into reusable standards or libraries. - Deep experience with PLC-based SCADA systems, including controller architecture, I/O design, program structure, and redundancy. - Demonstrated experience developing P&IDs for mechanical and/or electrical systems, including instrument and valve tagging and revision control. - Strong command of integration protocols and industrial networking (Modbus TCP/IP, BACnet/IP, IEC 61850, SNMP). - Strong understanding of datacenter cooling systems and working knowledge of electrical power monitoring across switchgear, UPS, PDU, and generator equipment. - Strong communication skills and the ability to operate credibly across mechanical, electrical, controls, IT, and operations disciplines. 
  Nice to Have  
 - Professional Engineer (P.Eng/PE) license. - Experience developing controls standards or a sequence library for a multi-site portfolio or hyperscale program. 
  Why this role matters  
 A standard library of Sequences of Operation is one of the highest-leverage controls deliverables Nscale can own. It converts control behavior from a per-project negotiation into a specified, reusable standard. Standardized points lists per equipment type are the foundation of every downstream capability, including SCADA development, alarming, trending, analytics, and reporting. Without an internal owner enforcing these standards up front, integration problems appear late in the process and at maximum cost. This role is what keeps control design, vendor equipment, and commissioning aligned as Nscale's datacenter portfolio scales. 
  What We Can Offer You  
 At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core. 
 - Highly competitive package (base + equity) with reviews every 12 months. 🚀 - Join the fastest-growing tech startup, your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI. ✨ - Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support. - Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments. 
  Equal Opportunities Statement  
 At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds. 
 If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.     The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.   Salary Range   $110,000  —  $200,000 USD       For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice:  Here.

About Nscale  
 Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility. 
 Our Design & Engineering team owns the technical standards that every datacenter project is built on, from Basis of Design documents through equipment catalogs and scopes of work. As Nscale scales one of the most ambitious AI datacenter programs in the world, this team is the backbone that keeps design decisions consistent, current, and usable across every region. 
 We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future. 
  About The Role  
 We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the program that keeps Nscale's design record aligned across every function that depends on it, including engineering, cost and schedule project controls, supply chain, construction, and operations. 
 - You'll own the full catalog of Basis of Design documents, Scopes of Work, equipment catalogs, and Requirements evaluations across Nscale's global portfolio. - When a regional team starts a new project, they'll start from your catalog. When an engineer proposes a design change, you'll run the cross-functional review that gets it vetted, approved, and propagated. - This is a program management role rather than a design authoring role. You'll need enough technical fluency to hold credible conversations with discipline engineers, paired with strong program discipline, stakeholder management, and structured decision-making. - You'll treat cost per MW and schedule duration as first-class program inputs, not background context. - This role starts as an individual contributor, with the expectation that you'll build a small team and/or manage AI-assisted and contract resources as the catalog and program demand grow. 
  What You'll be Doing  
 - Own the program that maintains and version-controls Nscale's full library of Basis of Design documents across all datacenter typologies, coordinating discipline engineers as content authors and reviewers. - Manage the library of Scopes of Work covering all major design disciplines, project types, and delivery strategies, driving them to a level of precision that supports accurate fee proposals and contract execution. - Own the change management program for all BoDs, SOWs, equipment catalogs, and design standards, from change request through discipline review, cost and schedule assessment, approval, versioning, and distribution. - Own the program that maintains approved equipment lists tied to each BoD, partnering with supply chain and procurement to validate availability, lead times, pricing, and vendor performance. - Own Nscale's Requirements evaluation framework, the structured technical assessment used to evaluate candidate colocation and leased datacenter facilities against Nscale's design standards. - Build and deliver structured "101" education programs on Nscale's design standards for internal teams, A/E partners, and external audiences. - Serve as the single point of coordination between design and the functions that consume design output, including cost and schedule project controls, supply chain, construction, operations, and Finance. - Identify and deploy AI tools and contract resources to scale document production, maintenance, and QA without proportional headcount growth. 
  About You  
 - 5+ years of experience in technical program management, project management, engineering, or design management within datacenters, mission-critical infrastructure, industrial facilities, or related capital-intensive construction. - Broad multi-discipline technical fluency across mechanical, electrical, civil, structural, and architectural systems, sufficient to review BoD content and hold credible conversations with discipline experts. - Demonstrated experience managing technical documentation programs such as Basis of Design documents, technical specifications, scopes of work, or equivalent design standards libraries. - Proven ability to drive alignment across functions that do not report to you, including engineering, cost and schedule project controls, supply chain, construction, and operations. - Strong process orientation, with experience designing and managing document control, change management, or configuration management workflows in a technical environment. - Working knowledge of cost/MW benchmarks and schedule duration assumptions for datacenter or mission-critical infrastructure design and construction. - Excellent technical writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex engineering intent into clear, unambiguous written standards. - Comfortable working with AI tools, document automation platforms, and digital collaboration environments. 
  Nice to Have

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Design team at ElevenLabs is crafting experiences for the next generation of audio workflows using generative AI. You’ll work in entirely new and unexplored problem spaces, like crafting experiences around voice cloning that will allow people to generate content in realistic voices, languages, and accents, to create universally accessible content, safely. You’ll reimagine how creative teams craft sounds just by describing them, and how they bring it all together in one AI-first generative audio platform. The work here has the potential to revolutionize workflows for creators to media and entertainment, publishing giants, to defining entirely new spaces like conversational AI companies.

You will work with our Engineering and AI Research teams to successfully communicate, evolve, and execute a strong product design standard that showcases ElevenLabs as an innovator in the generative AI audio space. You are a crucial component of our company’s growth and product launches through your contributions to short and long-term strategic direction, creating and maintaining high visual standards and a strong focus on user needs. You have an owner’s mentality, taking pride in your work and in your team’s work, and view what you do as a part-owner and builder of ElevenLabs.

You'll work closely with Nev Flynn https://nevflynn.com/,  Austin Malerba https://x.com/austin_malerba?lang=en, and collaborate closely with our frontend engineers to achieve outcomes.

If you love the intersection of design and engineering, as well as having an interest in the business side this could be a great fit. You might be a designer turned engineer, an engineer turned designer, or an ex-founder.



WHAT YOU BRING

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic product designers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects and designs. Even directly sharing a rough figma of your work is a great way to show us your craft! We do require:

 - Creative thinking toward establishing and executing on the vision for team initiatives. Challenge the status quo, push innovation and inspire people toward a unified outcome.

 - Efficiently execute to ship products that deliver impact for our business and customers.

 - Partner with the leadership team to successfully communicate concisely across the team and influence product and design outcomes.

 - Will work across the entire business stack and make an impact at different stages of the product: building vision & strategy, ensuring all the loose ends are tied up when executing, and making sure the operational components to support onboarding are in place, not just the product

 - It is preferred that you can get in the weeds with your engineering partners and make sense of technical constraints, while still pushing forward and maintaining a high design bar and level of execution

 - Work closely with stakeholders across the organization, partnering with Engineering, Customer Support, and Growth to define new products and features and launch them




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in  London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

e078201204b4e2e0.jd:

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.




TEAM INTEGRATION

 - Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

 - Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

 - Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

 - Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success




ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

 - Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

 - Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

 - Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

 - Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

 - Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

 - Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

 - Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

 - Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.



ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:


PRODUCT DESIGN

 - Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

 - Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

 - Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

 - Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

 - Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

 - Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.


UX RESEARCH & STRATEGY

 - Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

 - Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

 - Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

 - Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

 - Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

 - Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

 - Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in  design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.


WEB & BRAND EXPERIENCE

 - Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.

 - Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.

 - Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.

 - Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.




ROLE REQUIREMENTS



 - Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.

 - Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.

 - Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.

 - Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

 - Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.

 - Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.

 - Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers.

 - Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English.

 - A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.

 - Comfortable working 100% remotely in a distributed team.

 - Willingness to travel occasionally for team retreats and workshops.








Why WunderGraph?

The Process

9e1ab1a327e2d6b3.title: Staff Product Designer
9e1ab1a327e2d6b3.jd:
Mission
To advance the adoption of the Walrus Protocol – a Verifiable Data Platform for AI Builders

Vision
To create a foundation for AI builders to store and manage their data, making that data persistent, portable, and under their control across apps, providers, and agents.

Walrus Foundation is looking for a Staff Product Designer to define and own the product experience for Walrus.



Walrus is infrastructure for developers, and designing infrastructure products requires a particular kind of product thinking. Users need to navigate technical concepts, understand system state, work with large amounts of information, configure resources, diagnose problems, and take actions that can have real consequences for their data, storage, or spend.



You'll partner closely with product and engineering from the earliest stages of discovery through implementation. You won't receive finished requirements and turn them into screens. You'll help determine which problems matter, investigate how developers actually work, challenge assumptions, prototype and test potential solutions, and ultimately define how developers experience Walrus.



As a Staff designer, you'll also establish the systems and standards that allow the product to scale. You'll think beyond individual features to create consistent interaction patterns, reusable components, and product principles that make the entire Walrus experience more coherent over time.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the Walrus product experience. Define and evolve the end-to-end developer experience across Walrus's product surfaces and key workflows.

 - Lead discovery with product and engineering. Help frame problems before the team jumps to solutions, identify unanswered questions, and determine what evidence we need before committing to build.

 - Bring developers directly into the design process. Conduct lightweight developer interviews and usability tests, put prototypes in front of real users, and synthesize findings into decisions the team can act on.

 - Design complex technical workflows. Create flows, wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready designs for experiences involving dense data, system state, configuration, resource management, and high-consequence actions.

 - Influence product direction. Bring a strong point of view on what Walrus should build—not just how features should look—and constructively challenge product and engineering assumptions when needed.

 - Build Walrus's design system. Establish and maintain shared components, interaction patterns, and product principles that create consistency and allow the product surface to grow without fragmenting.

 - Benchmark the market. Regularly tear down comparable developer and infrastructure products to understand established patterns, identify opportunities, and avoid reinventing solved problems.

 - Stay close through implementation. Partner with engineering throughout development, review what ships against the intended experience, catch problems early, and incorporate requirements and feedback from partners such as Legal.

 - Raise the design bar. Establish what excellent developer-product design looks like for Walrus and help create the practices that maintain that standard as the organization grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8-10 years of product design experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex technical products.

 - A portfolio demonstrating ownership of shipped developer tools, cloud/infrastructure products, consoles, dashboards, or similarly complex technical products.

 - Demonstrated ability to simplify technically sophisticated workflows without removing the control or information expert users need.

 - Strong interaction-design skills across data-heavy interfaces, tables, configuration, complex states, progressive disclosure, permissions, errors, and high-consequence actions.

 - Experience independently identifying and framing product problems rather than primarily executing against predefined requirements.

 - A track record of influencing product strategy and roadmap decisions through design.

 - Strong qualitative research instincts and experience incorporating lightweight user research and usability testing into day-to-day product work.

 - Experience creating or significantly evolving design systems and reusable interaction patterns.

 - Strong partnership with engineering and a willingness to remain involved through implementation and design QA.

 - Excellent communication skills and the confidence to disagree constructively with senior product and engineering partners.

c862d06c892aff1b.title: Senior Product Designer
c862d06c892aff1b.jd:
SENIOR PRODUCT DESIGNER @ SECFIX

Location: Remote (EMEA) · CET/CEST timezone

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

How do you feel about owning a feature from the first customer conversation to the version that's live on production — writing the spec yourself, pairing closely with engineers through the build, and overseeing your design shipped on production exactly the way you designed it? If that sounds like the right shape of the job — designer who owns, not designer who hands off — read on.

I've spent most of my career believing the best designers aren't the ones with the prettiest Figma files. They're the ones who can frame a problem, write a spec, sit with engineers through the build, and own that what shipped is what they designed. Our founding product designer, Ghada https://www.linkedin.com/in/ghadashebl/, has been doing exactly that since we started. The engineering team has doubled and we're shipping faster than we ever have. We're hiring the second designer because there's more good work to do than one person can hold — and we'd rather ship twice as much than slow down.


WHY SECFIX EXISTS

Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.

Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.

We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to European market leadership.

This space is not threatened by AI, it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of product design work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.




WHAT WE BELIEVE

Compliance software has historically been built like the audit it automates — heavy, defensive, ugly. We're building something else. The customer is a real person trying to ship audit-ready evidence on a Friday afternoon. The product should respect their time, automate the boring parts, and make the rest feel calm.

Quality is the product. Most of our category competes on feature lists. We compete on craft. A clear empty state, a sync that doesn't lie, a settings page that holds together at eleven permission tiers — these are the things customers feel before they can name them. Design at Secfix is not what wraps the product. It's most of what makes it work.




WHAT THE ROLE IS

We expect strong design skill, strong product thinking, and the ability to hold your own in a technical discussion. You work in a small team — usually with one or two engineers — and pair closely from the first prototype through to production. You own the project from beginning to end.

Alongside the features you ship, you do three things that make everyone else faster:

 - Maintain the components and patterns that make design fast.

 - Own how the team ships. We have no PMs. You write the specs, run the ticketing workflow, keep engineers unblocked.

 - Build the tools and skills — Cursor rules, design QA skills, prompt templates — that let engineers do good design work without you in the room.

The leverage is doing all four well. Doing only one is the wrong shape.




HOW WE WORK

 - No PMs. Designers and engineers run product. You talk to customers, frame the problem, write the spec, decide what ships.

 - Small temporary teams. You plus one or two engineers per project. Whoever is closest to the problem leads.

 - Design leads the logic, engineering tests feasibility. You bring the V1. Engineers push back on what's expensive or risky, start ahead with system design. They help spot edge cases. You adjust it fast. We get from v1 to v4 in matter of hours or few days.

 - Prototype-grade, not wireframes. Real components, real states, real copy. Sometimes an LLM-built prototype before Figma. The component library stays current because the speed of design depends on it.

 - Handoff is the beginning, not the end. You're in the engineering channel. You review the PR. You verify on production. Staging QA is the first gate, not the last.

 - In-sync culture with thoughtful coms mindset. Loom for reviews, Notion for specs, quick loops in Gather where written coms doesn’t cut it, all happening in the same time zone. Team mates are reviewing things quick. Engineers and designers spend under two hours weekly meetings.

 - AI is part of the craft. We use Claude to pressure-test ideas, draft specs, surface edge cases, write test cases. Not to skip thinking.


THE FIRST THREE MONTHS

 - Month 1. Ship your first design to production. Get into the codebase, the customer language, the way we write specs. Sit on customer calls.

 - Month 2. Own a full feature end-to-end. Customer conversations, problem framing, Figma, spec, engineer pairing, PR review, production verification.

 - Month 3 and beyond. Push the design system forward. Start building the tools and skills that make engineers faster at design. Improve the product design process. The bar is yours to defend.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 8+ years designing B2B SaaS desktop applications as Staff/Principal Product Designer or similar. Dense interfaces — tables, filters, permissions, settings pages.

 - You've been the only designer, or one of two or three, in companies under 50 people at least once before. You know how to set the bar without a design org behind you.

 - Your portfolio is "I," not "we." You can name the engineer you paired with on each feature, the design decision you defended through the build, and what happened when the feature reached users.

 - You communicate clearly and concise in English: in Slack, in docs and on a call.

 - You're fast in Figma with or without AI. You’re already in a serious relationship with LLMs.

 - You treat engineering feasibility as input, not constraint. When an engineer says "three weeks, here's why," you find the version that's 80% as good and ships next week.

 - You're comfortable doing product work without the PM title.

 - You hear feedback and come back the next day with something better. You don't spend the hour in between defending the version that's already outdated.




COMPENSATION

Salary + equity based on experience. The offered compensation depends on the individual's qualifications assessed during the interview process.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Generous equity. Everyone is an owner.

 - 26 days holiday + local public holidays.

 - Comprehensive health insurance.

 - €1,000 annual personal development budget.

 - Remote workspace and co-working budget.

 - Latest equipment.

 - Team summits 1-2x per year. Recent ones: Costa Brava, Austrian Alps, Milan.

 - Local hubs in Munich, Berlin, London. Visa support if you want to relocate.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

We aim to invite you to a first conversation within a week and give feedback after every stage.

 - Intro call with talent team

 - Portfolio conversation with product designer (~45 min)

 - Take home design exercise and presentation (~3 hours)

 - Virtual team onsite (~2 hours)

Order may flex depending on availability. If you make it to the exercise and don't get an offer, we'll tell you specifically what got in the way.




LEARN HOW WE THINK AND WORK

 - How we designed remote culture at Secfix https://www.notion.so/How-we-designed-remote-culture-at-Secfix-33348601ddf880f8930adfe6f044040c?pvs=21

 - Thoughtful communication at Secfix https://www.notion.so/Thoughtful-communication-at-Secfix-33448601ddf88090b8e5dce0875087f7?pvs=21

 - Building production-grade product with AI in 2026 https://www.notion.so/Building-production-grade-product-with-AI-in-2026-33448601ddf8808997bafcc9f4ec83df?pvs=21

 - Building what customers need, not what they ask for https://www.notion.so/Building-what-customers-need-not-what-they-ask-for-33448601ddf880b89f0dd9e1b29da3b4?pvs=21

 - Our zero-bug policy https://www.notion.so/Our-zero-bugs-policy-33448601ddf8807d8a33ec2dd0dbc20b?pvs=21

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU — Karri Saarinen's Config talk
   
   

We are an equal-opportunity employer and a remote-only company. We hire within EU time zones. We work in sync using Gather as our virtual office and don't support fully asynchronous work.
